title: ToolCall
description: A provider-agnostic request from the model to invoke one tool (F-ADP-03). Adapters translate OpenAI tool_calls, Anthropic tool_use blocks, Gemini functionCall parts, and Ollama tool_calls into this shape. Parallel calls are an ordered array of ToolCall on the response (GavioResponse.toolCalls) or on an assistant message (message.toolCalls). Audit records keep only `name` and the arguments hash — never `arguments` (see AuditRecord.toolCalls). The arguments hash is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `arguments`: object keys sorted ascending by Unicode code point at every depth, no insignificant whitespace (separators ',' and ':'), UTF-8 without \u escaping of non-ASCII characters.

id.description: Correlates this call with the tool-role message that carries its result (message.toolCallId). Taken from the provider when it supplies one (OpenAI id, Anthropic tool_use id). Providers that do not supply ids (Gemini, Ollama) get a deterministic synthetic id `call_<index>_<name>`, where <index> is the zero-based position of the call within the response.

name.description: Name of the tool to invoke; matches ToolDefinition.name.

arguments.description: Parsed JSON arguments. Always an object — a provider that sends arguments as a JSON string (OpenAI) is parsed by the adapter; an empty string becomes {}. Arguments that are not a JSON object are a provider error, not a ToolCall.
